author: ingolf-lohmann
body:
## Product-Owner policy

Effective immediately: **ZERO BUG POLICY**.

Every open repository issue is an active defect/work item and must have an autonomous, repository-native, causally bound execution path to closure. An issue may remain open only while work is actively progressing or while a precisely evidenced non-resolvable external condition exists.

The repository must continuously sweep the complete open-issue backlog, dispatch all currently actionable issues, resume stalled/recoverable work, and close issues only after their own acceptance conditions are actually satisfied.

No issue may become a passive specification archive. No routine intermediate GitHub state may be delegated back to the Product Owner.

This policy does not authorize false closure, weakened gates, fabricated evidence, publication, merge, or external effects. `OWNER_DECISION`, implementation, independent review, observed effect, and completion evidence remain distinct.

Required implementation is being produced on a dedicated branch/PR rather than leaving this issue as the solution.
title: Zero Bug Policy: drain every open issue to closure
